functions.name: metadata.fn_entity_key_reference_valid(jsonb,text)
metadata.trg_validate_entity_field_contract()

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX entity_field_pii_inventory_idx ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, data_classification, entity_id, field_key) WHERE ((data_classification = ANY (ARRAY['pii'::text, 'sensitive_pii'::text])) AND ((status)::text = 'active'::text))
CREATE INDEX ix_entity_field_change_set_status ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, change_set_id, status, field_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_entity_field_replacement ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, change_set_id, replacement_field_key) WHERE (replacement_field_key IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX ix_entity_field_storage_path ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, change_set_id, storage_path) WHERE (storage_path IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entity_field_key_uq ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, change_set_id, field_key) NULLS NOT DISTINCT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entity_field_pkey ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX entity_field_tenant_id_uq ON metadata.entity_field USING btree (tenant_id, id) NULLS NOT DISTINCT

triggers.name: trg_entity_field_10_graph_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_entity_field_10_graph_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON metadata.entity_field FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION metadata.trg_guard_entity_graph_row('field_key')

triggers.name: trg_entity_field_30_contract
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_entity_field_30_contract BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON metadata.entity_field FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION metadata.trg_validate_entity_field_contract()

triggers.name: trg_entity_field_90_updated_at
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_entity_field_90_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON metadata.entity_field FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION shared.trg_set_updated_at()

triggers.name: trg_entity_field_95_graph_validate
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trg_entity_field_95_graph_validate AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON metadata.entity_field DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION metadata.trg_validate_entity_graph_deferred()

constraints.name: entity_field_audit_pair_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((updated_at IS NULL) = (updated_by IS NULL)))

constraints.name: entity_field_change_set_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (change_set_id) REFERENCES metadata.entity_change_set(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: entity_field_classification_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK ((data_classification = ANY (ARRAY['public'::text, 'internal'::text, 'confidential'::text, 'pii'::text, 'sensitive_pii'::text])))

constraints.name: entity_field_computation_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((value_origin)::text = 'computed'::text) AND ((write_mode)::text = 'computed'::text) AND (computation_spec IS NOT NULL)) OR (((value_origin)::text <> 'computed'::text) AND ((write_mode)::text <> 'computed'::text) AND (computation_spec IS NULL))))

constraints.name: entity_field_created_by_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES master.principal(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: entity_field_default_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((default_spec IS NULL) OR (((value_origin)::text = 'stored'::text) AND ((write_mode)::text = ANY (ARRAY['mutable'::text, 'write_once'::text])))))

constraints.name: entity_field_description_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((description IS NULL) OR ((btrim(description) <> ''::text) AND (length(description) <= 2000))))

constraints.name: entity_field_entity_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (entity_id) REFERENCES metadata.entity(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: entity_field_key_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK ((field_key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$'::text))

constraints.name: entity_field_key_uq
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, change_set_id, field_key)

constraints.name: entity_field_lifecycle_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (replacement_field_key IS NULL) AND (deprecated_since_release_no IS NULL) AND (planned_removal_release_no IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'deprecated'::text) AND (deprecated_since_release_no >= 1) AND ((planned_removal_release_no IS NULL) OR (planned_removal_release_no > deprecated_since_release_no)))))

constraints.name: entity_field_optional_specs_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((default_spec IS NULL) OR (jsonb_typeof(default_spec) = 'object'::text)) AND ((computation_spec IS NULL) OR (jsonb_typeof(computation_spec) = 'object'::text)) AND ((validation_spec IS NULL) OR (jsonb_typeof(validation_spec) = 'object'::text))))

constraints.name: entity_field_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: entity_field_projected_write_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((value_origin)::text <> 'projected'::text) OR ((write_mode)::text = 'read_only'::text)))

constraints.name: entity_field_replacement_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((replacement_field_key IS NULL) OR ((replacement_field_key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$'::text) AND (replacement_field_key <> field_key))))

constraints.name: entity_field_retention_policy_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((retention_policy_code IS NULL) OR (retention_policy_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{1,62}$'::text)))

constraints.name: entity_field_storage_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((value_origin)::text = ANY (ARRAY['stored'::text, 'projected'::text])) AND (storage_path ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]{0,126}$'::text)) OR (((value_origin)::text = ANY (ARRAY['computed'::text, 'runtime'::text])) AND (storage_path IS NULL))))

constraints.name: entity_field_tenant_id_uq
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, id)

constraints.name: entity_field_type_config_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(type_config) = 'object'::text) AND ((type_config ->> 'kind'::text) = (data_type)::text)))

constraints.name: entity_field_updated_by_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES master.principal(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: trg_entity_field_95_graph_validate
constraints.definition: TRIGGER DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
